description: Plan what happens to your digital life — the account inventory, the access plan that doesn't violate terms or law, platform legacy settings, and the memorialize/delete/preserve decisions, written down while it's easy. Use when asked what happens to my accounts when I die, set up a digital legacy plan, help an executor deal with online accounts, or how does my family get into my stuff.
